browser.definizione: The program you use to visit websites, such as Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge.

archiviazione-locale.definizione: A small space the browser reserves for each website to save data on your device. The data stays only in that browser and on that device.

cloud.definizione: Real computers, sitting in a company's data centers, that you use over the internet without having them physically in front of you.

github.definizione: A website where people who develop software keep, share and work on their projects, including together with others.

codespaces.definizione: A GitHub service that gives you, in a few seconds, a ready-made computer in the cloud to use inside your browser.
